observations: The page number «98» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. The page has no signature. L01 begins a new paragraph after the end of p. 97 (JP2 0129, L36). L08, L10: «59a», the a raised.

L01-L15. Checked with al-Khwārizmī's obliquity 23° 51′: the right ascension of 297° 3′, counted from the beginning of Capricorn as in Tables 59-59b, is 29° 10′; 29° 10′ + 35° 52′ = 65° 2′, + 35° 52′ = 100° 54′, + 35° 52′ = 136° 46′, + 24° 8′ = 160° 54′, + 24° 8′ = 185° 2′, + 24° 8′ = 209° 10′, and 209° 10′ − 29° 10′ = 180°. The longitudes belonging to these right ascensions are 3° 1′ of Pisces, 11° 53′ of Aries, 19° 19′ of Taurus, 12° 26′ of Gemini, 4° 36′ and 27° 3′ of Cancer (L04-L15: 11° 54′, 12° 25′); 27° 3′ of Cancer is the point opposite 27° 3′ of Capricorn, as L15 says.

L17-L21 and L24-L25: two tables of six columns divided by vertical rules, the houses at the head of each column. Each printed row is one line here, the cells separated by our «|». A small speck before «19° 19′» (L18) and others before «Die» (L26) and above «aber» (L27) are not transcribed.

L22-L28. Checked: the differences between the values of Table 88 and those computed are 0′, 7′, 8′, 12′, 8′ and 0′, «zwischen 0′ und 12′». The values of Table 88 are to be compared with the table. By the same rule, with the obliquity 23° 51′, no latitude reproduces the five values II-VI together: the latitude 38° 26′ gives 3° 7′, 12° 4′, 19° 33′, 12° 35′ and 4° 41′, each within 5′ of the row.

L35-L36: the heading of chapter 37, in bold, centred, with the reference to the text below it in smaller type. Checked: chapter 37 stands on pp. 30-31 of the text (JP2 0062-0063). L37-L41: 60°, 90° and 120°, the sextile, the quadrature and the trine.

The dashes: L09 «Hauses. — Nun», the long dash (48 px) with a space on either side; L31 «4—56» (38 px), L36 «30—31» and «91—114» (37 and 33 px, the smaller type): long dashes, set close. L15 «Aszendenten, = 27° 3′», as printed.
Italics: «Proiectiones radiorum,», «Sextil-», «Quadrat-», «Trigonalschein», «Aspekten». «der Wage» (L21), the spelling of the edition.
The colons and semicolons stand after the thin space of the edition (10-14 px measured); L23 «Tierkreiszeichen):», the colon set close after the parenthesis (5 px).
